newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Wesfi sees 96/97 year operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Wesfi sees 96/97 year operating loss.

text.p: Timber group Wesfi Ltd said on Thursday it expected to report an operating loss for the year to June 30, 1997 due to deteriorated market conditions and no upturn in the housing market.
Wesfi, formerly Westralian Forest Industries Ltd, said it had previously expected an improvement in the second half.

"However, since February, market conditions for the company's products in Australia and overseas have deteriorated and the long-anticipated improvement in new housing commencements in Australia has not yet begun," Wesfi said.
In addition, the recent strikes by unions in Western Australia resulted in unplanned production stoppages which cost the company in the order of A$l million, it said.
"Under the circumstances, your directors now anticipate that Wesfi will report an operating loss for the year to June 1997."
Wesfi reported an 85.4 percent drop in net profit to A$302,000 forn the six months ended Decemeber 31, 1996.
In the 1995/96 year, Wesfi reported a net profit of A$1.42 million, down from A$10.60 million a year earlier.
At 10.50 a.m. (0050 GMT), Wesfi shares were steady at A$2.00.
